newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Vendex services unit to make "substantial" IPO.
newsitem.headline: Vendex services unit to make "substantial" IPO.

text.p: Vendex chairman Jan-Michiel Hessels said on Monday the group's demerged business services unit would make a "substantial" initial public offering of new shares as part of the demerger process later this year.

Hessels did not say how large the offering would be but said it would be big enough for Vendex to recover "a substantial part" of the more than 800 million guilders it plans to pay for French temporary employment agency BIS.
Hessels told a news conference that the demerger and separate Dutch bourse listing of the business services division was expected to be completed in the first half of 1997.
He said that as part of the demerger plan Vendex shareholders would receive one "retail" share and one "business services" share in exchange for each existing Vendex share.
Vendex said that after the BIS takeover its business services division would rank third in Europe in temporary employment services and second in commercial cleaning.
